notes.title: Forgotlings will launch in early Fall 2025—watch video with Throughline devs
notes.notes: [p]We have an important update regarding the release of Forgotlings. While we've been working tirelessly to bring you the best experience possible, we’ve decided to push the launch date further back to early Fall 2025 to ensure it meets the high standards we know you expect and deserve.[/p][p]To dive deeper into what we’ve been working on and what we hope to accomplish with the extra development time, here's a special video featuring our cofounders Alfred Nguyen & Michael Godlowski-Maryniak, as well as other members of our indie dev team at Throughline Games.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="X_lAmrNR3Tw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We also have a very special deep-dive interview with the lovely folks at Indie Games Devel, where Alfred and Michael discuss Forgotlings & Forgotton Anne in great depth—the story, gameplay, development process, and our decision to push back the launch of Forgotlings until Fall 2025.[/p][p]"With [i]Forgotlings[/i], we believe we’re hitting an even higher emotional crescendo by the time the story reaches its climax and conclusion."[/p][p][url="https://indiegamesdevel.com/forgotlings-a-deep-dive-into-the-enchanted-and-animated-realm-of-the-forgotten-lands-with-creative-director-alfred-nguyen-and-technical-director-michael-godlowski-maryniak/"]https://indiegamesdevel.com/forgotlings-a-deep-dive-into-the-enchanted-and-animated-realm-of-the-forgotten-lands-with-creative-director-alfred-nguyen-and-technical-director-michael-godlowski-maryniak/[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/f785102abbdd66f7d1827ab91781235d6b79a80f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We understand that the extra wait can be frustrating for our fans and players, and we truly appreciate your patience and support. This extra time will allow us to polish the game, finalize some quality-of-life features that elevate the combat gameplay experience based on playtesting feedback, and make the game the very best that it can be.[/p][p]With the extra months of development, we’ll be able to have the game localized in more languages so that many more players around the world can enjoy this epic adventure across the Forgotten Lands. We’ll also have the time to prepare for all the logistics surrounding a launch, including collaborations with content creators and taking the proper marketing steps with press outlets to help make the launch a success. Last but not least, the game is huge in scope, and we want to dedicate enough time and resources to quality assurance and polish to ensure that you’ll have the best bug-free gameplay experience while playing.[/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey with us—your excitement and encouragement mean the world! In the meantime, we’ll be sharing more video interviews, updates, sneak peeks, and behind-the-scenes content to keep you posted.[/p][p]Stay tuned, and we can't wait to share Forgotlings with you soon! 🎮❤️[/p][p]—Throughline Games[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/6de34b7aa8dd748a478f62f65642a69cc2d3560f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Forgotlings launches on June 12—Enjoy the brand new release date trailer!
notes.notes:
[h1]Release date announcement 📢 [/h1]
It's official: Forgotlings launches on June 12!

Mark your calendars 🗓️ make sure you've wishlisted on Steam 🎮 and enjoy the brand new Forgotlings release date trailer below 🎬✨

[previewyoutube=wfjXWA5QW78;full][/previewyoutube]
And that’s not all—we want as many of you as possible to experience the first game in our franchise, Forgotton Anne. Stay tuned, as we’ll soon be announcing massive discounts! 🚀

[h2]Forgotlings Release Date Revealed – The Next Chapter in the Forgotten Lands Arrives on June 12th 2025[/h2]
[h3]New Trailer Showcases Stunning Hand-Drawn Adventure from the Creators of Forgotton Anne[/h3]

After five years in the making and a successful Kickstarter campaign, the highly-anticipated sequel to Forgotton Anne is nearly here. Throughline Games has officially revealed that Forgotlings will launch on the 12th of June for Steam, and is expected shortly after on other platforms. To celebrate, a brand-new Release Date Trailer has been unveiled today, giving players a deeper look at the game’s breathtaking world & cinematic 2D handcrafted storytelling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/caad2a89f463b04740c511461bec20153d41a0ac.png[/img]
Fans of emotionally driven, story-rich games who have yet to experience the unique universe of Forgotton Anne should consider taking advantage of upcoming discounts on the title — an ideal way to experience the world before Forgotlings arrives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/65f033a3ab0c4611dfc455c9d681d43fa2b87cf2.png[/img]

[h2]A New Standalone Adventure in the World of the Forgotten[/h2]

In Forgotlings, players take on the role of Fig, a charismatic posing doll navigating a fractured world to unite five forgotling tribes. Forgotlings are sentient lost objects longing to rediscover their purpose as a Beast threatens to destroy the Forgotten Lands. As he explores lush forgotten landscapes, battles enigmatic foes, and uncovers ancient secrets, Fig must determine his place in a world where memories are power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/431ffacf93f20faa98b9959ec44dccf418a07c2c.png[/img]
With stunning hand-drawn visuals, a haunting score featuring renowned choir ensemble Theatre of Voices, a deep narrative with choice mechanics, and an expansive, action-packed world, Forgotlings builds upon its predecessor’s beloved storytelling while offering an entirely new, standalone experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/cab1dbbfe2ea60fba0b76cab3630d09aec2ebba6.png[/img]
"In a world increasingly divided, Forgotlings invites players to escape into the Forgotten Lands—where their choices shape the fate of a fractured society. This is a story of belonging, of tribal factions at odds, and of finding purpose in a time of uncertainty.” says Alfred Nguyen, Creative Director at Throughline Games. “While we didn’t set out to make a timely allegory, the themes of Forgotlings resonate now more than ever."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/19c6ed6d5ca874ba1b0c167cc02377dcac341f3f.png[/img]

[h2]Wishlist Forgotlings Now – And Watch the New Trailer![/h2]
Forgotlings is now available for wishlisting on Steam, and players eager to experience the original world should stay tuned for upcoming news of Forgotton Anne’s Steam Spring Sale participation.
📺 Watch the Release Date Trailer here: https://youtu.be/wfjXWA5QW78
🛒 Wishlist Forgotlings on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2059570/Forgotlings/

notes.title: Forgotlings: Meet Fig
notes.notes:
Hi again, Forgotlings fans, and a very happy [url=https://www.nationaldaycalendar.com/november/national-fig-week-november-1-7]National Fig Week[/url] if you celebrate (and who wouldn't?)! What better way to recognize the holiday than to introduce you to Fig himself? 

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/c4f1800b56feab81657003621d0a29486c33e9ad.png[/img]
In the Forgotten Lands, a realm beyond our own, everyday objects transform into something more special, waking with newfound consciousness and becoming Forgotlings! But Fig, a posing doll, is even more extraordinary than that: he’s a Shooting Star, a rare sort of Forgotling that descends from what their world calls “The Ether”. Shooting Stars often possess vivid memories of their past lives as cherished objects in the human world – something which connects in our story to the face you see drawn on Fig's chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/451c35fcbf78f9d4aab02f6a72bdc122f835102c.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[i]Early art style experiments with Fig before it was clear how he was meant to be portrayed[/i]

Fig starts the game as a naive new spawn, exploring the world around him in nearly child-like wonder – and with so much out there to explore, our hero takes to the seas as the captain of a ship. As he journeys on, he quickly learns of the realm's five tribes… and before long, stumbles upon remnants of an ancient Forgotling civilization and whispers of the past.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/372b8596f646070b71d3eeb8cf7f54ca98a77c13.png[/img]
But Fig doesn't do this alone. Along the way, you'll encounter a number of vibrant Forgotlings with their own goals, quirks, and personalities… some easier to bond with than others. Fig does embody goodness and optimism – but just like in the human world, things aren’t always as simple as good versus evil. Your choices as a player will instead focus on how Fig can consider other Forgotlings' emotions and reactions, create meaningful interactions, and act with care around intentions and consequences in the context of the goodness within him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/badf8bad3f2639ef67b1b60805d0bb949af4e6f7.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀       [i]Silvia forms a deep bond with Fig and believes in his untapped potential[/i]

And while he fights the inner battle to hold to his values, Fig’s on a wider mission that couldn’t be higher-stakes: uniting the five tribes against a great danger, a mysterious beast who just might cause the end of the world. But he’s brave, charming, and good, and with someone like you behind him helping guide the way, perhaps success is just beyond the horizon…

[hr][/hr]

Don't forget to add Forgotlings to your wishlist and keep coming back to learn more about the magic that awaits. To see more exclusive concept art, engage with our creative community, and hear announcements first, be sure to [url=https://discord.com/invite/26P5c9p8sW]join our Discord here.[/url]

Forgotlings isn't setting sail just yet, but we sure would love to have you aboard. Our [url=https://discord.gg/MXaGDXZaJ2][b]Discord[/b] has officially launched[/url], and we want you right there with us.

Things are quiet right now as we get set, but we've already kicked off a channel of low-pressure creative challenges on #a-very-forgotlings-fall. Be the first to see exclusive concept art, shared only on our server. And very soon now, there'll be much more, and you want to be there from day one... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/5ee472e5c00ae4f9e72f8bcbcd45d984c58bda5b.png[/img]
Are you a [b]Servus [/b]protector? Or a [b]Sonavi[/b], born to bridge distances? Perhaps you're a knowledge-and-discussion loving [b]Videra [/b]-- or a contemplative, spiritual [b]Karus[/b]? Or maybe you're an influential resource, part of the [b]Aufero[/b]. Opt-in to your Forgotlings tribe now so that you can be ready the second they need you. 

Or maybe you don't know. But we'll have a way for you to know soon...! So if you're born for adventure, come to our server and let us be the first to find out along with you.

Come hang out with other lovers of metroidvania, action-adventure, and all things whimsy. Forgotton Anne fans, those coming from Kickstarter, and those new to this world -- we'd love to have you all.

notes.title: All Aboard The Forgotlings Steam Reveal!
notes.notes:
[h1]Prepare to embark on an unforgettable adventure[/h1] in the enchanting world of Forgotlings, brought to you by the talented developers of Forgotten Anne. Coming to PlayStation 4|5, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and PC via Steam in 2024, this breathtaking cinematic action adventure will transport you to a realm filled with forgotten objects and familiar characters! :rocket: 

Join Fig, the gifted posing doll, on an epic quest to unite different tribes of forgotlings against a menacing beast threatening to plunge the world into darkness. As the captain of The Volare, Fig's ship and base of operations, you'll lead a crew of forgotlings in exhilarating combat, blending hack-and-slash with strategy and stealth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/be299716dae0f0f972faafc9aa13d7ffc2429039.png[/img]

[h2]Delve into a mesmerizing 2.5D semi open-world[/h2] metroidvania, exploring hidden ancient secrets in the desert Dunes, scaling the majestic Agora Mountains, and beyond. Engage in interactive conversations, forge relationships, and shape the destiny of tribes through alliances you form along the way.

Challenge fellow forgotlings to the popular board game INA, unlocking intriguing dialogues and strengthening connections. Customize your INA decks with powerful Power Stones and test your skills against rivals. Can you ascend the ranks and claim the title of Grandmaster?
Prepare to be captivated by the thousands of meticulously hand-drawn animation frames, full voice acting, and an awe-inspiring score featuring Theatre of Voices. Immerse yourself in a world where imagination and emotion intertwine.

[h3]Mark your calendars![/h3] Forgotlings is set to launch on PlayStation 4|5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam in 2024. Don't miss out on rediscovering the power of forgotten things and embracing the diverse wonders of a world beyond our own! :milky_way:
